title: fix(lint): security-posture advisory sentences name each setting the way the console shows it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao8sLBKbwo7u4Ei8tV7JF4U9)_

Fixes #32843

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：7 条安全态势提示（权限集、对象共享、主从、行级策略）的十种非英文句子，逐语言对照控制台自己的语言包核对术语，改正了与界面不一致的设置名称；规则 id、参数和英文句子都没动。
- 为什么改：按裁决 A（不安排母语审读，由 agent 对照控制台语言包核对），管理员按句子去找设置时，句子里的名字必须和屏幕上的一致。核对发现：“查看所有记录 / 修改所有记录 / 读取范围 / 写入范围 / CHECK”只在 Studio 权限编辑器里出现，而它只有英文和中文，其它八种语言的管理员看到的是英文标签，句子却写了自造的译名；另外“所有者可编辑”开关、主从（父/子对象）用词、韩语“권한 세트”等也与界面不符。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个文案目录里的字符串值，不改逻辑、不改接口；这些句子要等 #32656 组装、#32657 渲染后才会被用户看到。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.user-text.ts` 顶部的 `BYPASS_LABEL`（八种语言改为界面实际显示的英文标签），以及 `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in` 的 `allow-owner-edit` 分支（各语言改为引用开关原名）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.test.ts`，预期全部通过（每种语言都不是英文兜底句）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：已按 pm-dispatch 审核清单核对：只改文案的值，规则 id、参数和测试钉都没动；设置名称按管理员实际看到的界面标签改正（Studio 权限编辑器只有英文和中文，所以其他 8 种语言引用英文界面标签），修复建议授予的权限与英文一致。按裁决 A，不需要母语审读。可落地。

## What changes

Ruling A (6840566887): the security-posture user sentences ship on the English-reviewed terms with no native read, and an agent checks each locale's terms against the console packs, above all the setting names and what the fix grants. This PR is that check and its data-only corrections, in `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.user-text.ts` (sentence values and `BYPASS_LABEL` values only).

**The one finding that drives most of the edits.** View All Records, Modify All Records, Read scope, Write scope and a policy's CHECK are edited only in the Studio permission editor (`PermissionMatrixEditor`), whose strings live in the `studio` namespace. That namespace ships `en` and `zh` only, by ruling (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/index.ts:10-13`), and `resolveStudioLanguage` (`index.ts:94`) serves every other language the `en` catalogue and `zh-Hant` the `zh` one. So an `ar`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `ja`, `ko`, `pt-BR` or `ru` admin sees these settings under their English labels, while the sentences named them by translations the console never shows. The corrections:

- `BYPASS_LABEL` for those eight locales is the label the screen shows: `View All Records` / `Modify All Records` (`studio/en.ts:30-31`). `zh-Hant` reads 查看所有記錄, the Traditional form of the `zh` label 查看所有记录 that screen shows it (`studio/zh.ts:22`), where it read 檢視.
- Where a sentence tells the admin to set a read or write scope, those eight locales keep their own words and add the screen label in parentheses: `Read scope`, `Write scope` (`studio/en.ts:3057-3058`). `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` already used 读取范围 / 写入范围 (`studio/zh.ts:2736-2737`).
- The update-policy sentence names the policy's `CHECK` (`studio/en.ts:124`, `studio/zh.ts:112`, the same keyword in both catalogues): `zh-Hans` / `zh-Hant` now read CHECK（写入过滤）条件 where they read 检查条件, and the other eight add `(CHECK)` to their own word.

**Other setting names.**

- The owner opt-in remedy (`allow-owner-edit`) names its switch by the object form's own label in each locale (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/LOCALE.metadata-forms.generated.ts:377`, "Owner may edit"), instead of a paraphrase.
- Master and detail follow each locale's console words: child object (`form.masterDetail.noChildObject`), parent object (`preview.changes.securityRule.cbpNoRelation`) and parent record (`element.relatedList.parentUnreadable`). The `zh` packs keep 主记录 for the master record, the Studio's own word (`studio/zh.ts:2125`); `es` already read objeto principal / registro principal, as its console does.
- `ko` names a permission set 권한 세트, the permission-set form's label (`ko.metadata-forms.generated.ts:2538`) and the pack's majority, where it read 권한 집합; particles follow the vowel ending (는 / 가 / 로).
- `de` names the record owner Eigentümer, as the "Owner may edit" switch does (`de.metadata-forms.generated.ts:377`), where it read Datensatzbesitzer.
- `ja` reads 読み取り for read, as its console does (`ja.ts:177`, `ja.ts:4579`), where it read 参照; 参照 stays where it means a reference (the master-reference field).

**What the fix grants.** Every remedy arm in every locale was read against the English: none grants more or less than the English does. The three field-mask arms keep their split (read: let the set read the field; edit and both: delete the field restriction), and the three owner-policy remedies keep theirs.

**Contract review nit N2 (record 6835490406), `security-update-policy-no-check`: not added.** The sentence already says the check condition is what bounds an update ("add a check condition to limit what an update may write"), which is the side effect's substance: once declared, the check, not the ownership floor, decides which rows an update may write, so a creator the check does not admit loses update. The hint's mechanism (USING-only siblings and the floor leaving the check) is the developer detail the catalog's header keeps in `hint` and `os explain`. Adding the caveat would also change the English-reviewed `en` sentence, which ruling A ships as is. Every locale therefore stays parallel to the English, without the caveat.

**Changeset:** `.changeset/32843-security-posture-console-terms.md`, `@objectstack/lint` patch, with both declaration lines.

## Tests

No test changes: no pin names a corrected word (the pins read the English sentences, the zh-Hans permission-set name and the rendered names). Run at `1d5360b3` (the final head, after the one `origin/main` merge):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/finding-user-text.test.ts src/validate-security-posture.test.ts src/validate-security-posture-extension-merge.test.ts src/validate-security-posture-fls-extension.test.ts src/validate-security-posture-owner-may-edit.test.ts src/validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts`: Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 409 passed (409) at `617f9108`. Every sentence still renders its names in every locale and is not the English stand-in.
- The other suites that read the merged catalog (`finding-user-text.connector-permission-form`, `.dashboards`, `.data-model`, `.pages-forms`, `validate-approval-approvers.unsupported-type`): Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 96 passed (96) at `617f9108`.
- All eleven files again at `1d5360b3` in one run: Test Files 11 passed (11), Tests 505 passed (505), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run typecheck`: exit 0.

No ablation: the diff changes string values, not a tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- **Console splits seen, not fixed here** (outside this card's file surface; each is a console pack or form translation, not this catalog):
  - `ko`: the Setup permission-set assignment screen says 권한 집합 (L/ko.ts:4919-4928), while the permission-set form (M/ko:2538) and the rest of the pack say 권한 세트. The sibling catalog `validate-retired-permission-residue.user-text.ts` also writes 권한 집합.
  - `zh-Hant`: the console pack says 共享 (L/zh-Hant.ts:3626) and the object form 共用 (M/zh-Hant:369); this catalog follows the object form, where the sharing settings are.
  - `es`: the pack says uso compartido, the object form's section label says Compartición (M/es-ES:369); this catalog follows the pack, which the form's own "Acceso y uso compartido" group (M/es-ES:1716) also uses.
